items.texto: My son used to feel overwhelmed by his homework and now he organizes it on his own. The daily support changed our afternoons at home.
The personalized English classes gave my daughter her confidence back. Her grades went up and she's no longer afraid to speak in class.
They helped me structure my thesis essay from scratch. I learned to organize my ideas, not just to hand in the work.
What I value most is the constant communication. I always know how my son is doing and where he's improving. You can tell they're patient with him.
I would send in my texts and get them back corrected and much clearer, with every change explained to me. Excellent editing and a warm, personal touch.
